question: Does the bestowal of form to beings contradict the deity's ultimate intent?
premises: By the surge of its own awareness-power, the deity bestows such a form to beings.
This bestowal appears as an outward giving of form.
The ultimate standpoint may differ from this appearance.
inference: Although the deity bestows form to beings, the ultimate truth of that act remains to be stated.
plain_english: Although, by the surge of his own power of awareness, this deity bestows such a form upon beings, nevertheless, in ultimate truth, the matter stands otherwise.
